en.headline: Police hold major inter-departmental exercise for Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: About 3,000 personnel took part in drills at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, Victoria Harbour and West Kowloon, including a simulated biochemical attack scenario.
body: The Hong Kong Police Force, together with multiple government departments and related organisations, conducted a comprehensive inter-departmental exercise on Wednesday night to prepare for the 94th INTERPOL General Assembly to be held in Hong Kong in late November.

The exercise covered on-site rehearsals of the opening and closing ceremonies and a range of conference arrangements, including VIP security and traffic coordination, crowd management for about 1,000 delegates, venue command centre operations and wireless network stress tests.

It also simulated a suspected biochemical terrorist attack in which an unattended backpack released an unknown gas during a cocktail reception, testing immediate tactical response, emergency medical decontamination and triage, and handling of suspicious items.

About 3,000 personnel from the Police, Fire Services Department, Hospital Authority, Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre management and the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority took part. Secretary for Security Chris Tang and Commissioner of Police Joe Chow inspected the exercise.

zh.headline: 警務處聯同多部門反恐演習 為國際刑警大會作準備
zh.dek: 約3000人參與在會展、維港及西九龍一帶的跨部門綜合演習，模擬疑似生化恐怖襲擊等情境。
body: 為確保11月底在香港舉行的國際刑警組織第94屆全體大會順利進行，警務處周三晚聯同多個政府部門及相關機構，在香港會議展覽中心、維多利亞港及西九龍一帶進行跨部門綜合演習。
演習包括大會開幕式與閉幕式實地綵排，以及貴賓安保與交通協調、約1000名與會代表人流管理、會場指揮中心運作及無線網絡壓力測試等一系列會議安排。
演習亦模擬在招待酒會期間發生疑似生化恐怖襲擊，一個無人看管的背包突然釋出不明氣體，測試即時戰術介入、緊急應變、傷者洗消和分流，以及處理可疑物品等關鍵環節。
演習動員約3000名人員參與，包括警務處、消防處、醫院管理局、會展管理公司及西九文化區管理局等。保安局局長鄧炳強及警務處處長周一鳴到場視察。
